**Company:** Alignerr ([Home](https://www.alignerr.com/))
**Logo Image:** [Alignerr Logo](https://www.alignerr.com/images/logo.svg)
**Role:** AI Training Specialist
**Compensation:** $40–$120/hr with weekly payouts
**Contract Type:** Hourly Contract, Remote, 10–40 hours/week, Freelance GENERAL
**Work Responsibilities:** Complete structured tasks—including labeling, classifying, and rating AI-generated content—to directly improve AI model accuracy and reliability
**Evaluation Modalities:** Evaluate AI outputs across text, image, and audio formats using clear rubrics and guidelines
**Writing and Feedback Rubric Skills:** Provide consistent, high-quality feedback reflecting real human judgment; communicate clearly in written English; strong critical analysis, writing, or editing background (nice-to-have)
**Hiring Requirements:** Detail-oriented and precise, self-motivated and reliable, comfortable with web-based platforms and digital tools, curious and adaptable; no prior AI, technical, or industry-specific experience required
**Nice-to-Have Qualifications:** Experience in content moderation, quality assurance, data entry, or research; familiarity with AI tools as an end user; background in writing, editing, or critical analysis
**Screening and Application Process:** Quick screening process; apply directly through the [Alignerr Application Portal](https://app.alignerr.com/signin?job=b7b95845-ac1a-4742-8537-094eb6ac59ee) or [Sign Up Page](https://app.alignerr.com/signup)
**Related Company Resources:** [Jobs Page](https://www.alignerr.com/jobs), [Process Page](https://www.alignerr.com/process), [Stories Page](https://www.alignerr.com/stories), [FAQs Page](https://www.alignerr.com/faqs), [Community Rules](https://www.alignerr.com/rules), [Terms & Privacy](https://www.alignerr.com/privacy)
**Social Media Profiles:** [Alignerr on X](https://twitter.com/alignerr_ai), [Alignerr on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/alignerr)

<summary>The page outlines the AI Training Specialist remote freelance position at Alignerr, detailing pay rates of $40-120/hr, weekly payouts, and a 10-40 hours/week commitment. It highlights core responsibilities like labeling and rating AI outputs across text, image, and audio formats. Essential qualifications emphasize attention to detail and written communication, while noting that no prior technical experience is required. Additional links for company processes, FAQs, and application submission portals are provided.</summary>

**Company:** micro1 ([Referral Program](https://www.micro1.ai/referral-program))
**Company Logo:** [micro1 Logo](https://micro1-portal-data.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/gptvetting/1773721023535-17057c0f-fc0d-4bfd-b261-8362cb83b589-micro1-new-logo.png)
**Role:** Generalist - AI Trainer (Part-time Contract, Remote)
**Pay:** $10 - $20/hour
**Job Status:** Currently closed and not accepting applications.
**Work Responsibilities:** Annotate diverse data types accurately and consistently, collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, provide constructive and actionable feedback to improve annotation guidelines, engage in regular written/verbal communication, participate in quality assurance checks, identify process improvements, and document key learnings and best practices.
**Required Skills & Qualifications:** Proven experience in data annotation, labeling, or related data quality roles; exceptional English communication skills (written and verbal); ability to deliver clear, constructive feedback; strong organizational skills for remote work; proactive teamwork in multicultural environments; adaptability to new tools and workflows; and a passion for continuous improvement.
**Preferred Qualifications:** Experience working with AI or machine learning datasets; familiarity with project management or collaboration tools such as Slack, Jira, and Trello; and a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.
**Writing & Feedback Rubric Skills:** Delivering clear, actionable, and constructive feedback; maintaining high accuracy and consistency in data annotation; documenting key learnings and best practices; strong written and verbal English communication with attention to detail.
**Interactive Elements:** An "Explore other opportunities" link is present on the page.

<summary>The page details the "Generalist" AI Trainer position at micro1, specifying a remote, part-time contract role paying $10-$20/hour. It outlines core duties including data annotation, team collaboration, and feedback delivery. Required qualifications emphasize annotation experience and strong English skills, while preferred traits include AI/ML dataset familiarity and project management tools like Slack and Jira. The page notes that the job is currently closed and provides links to referral programs and other opportunities.</summary>
